base: black canvas with a wet grey wash of phthalo green and alizarin crimson

steps.action: blend glow outward and keep a yellow center

steps.action: blend moon gently with large brush

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend cloud base with brush corner and fluff

steps.action: paint thin stringy clouds

steps.subject: structure
